आघुष् आ-घुष्, cl. 1. P. -घोषति, -घो-
षितुम्, to make one's self audible; to cry aloud, to
proclaim; to praise; to listen to: Caus. -घोषयति,
-यितुम्, to make a noise, to cause to sound; to pro-
claim or cause to proclaim aloud; to complain con-
tinually.

आघूर्ण् आ-घूर्ण्, cl. 6. P., 1. A. -घूर्णति,
-घूर्णते, -णितुम्, to fluctuate, stagger; to roll,
whirl.

आ-घूर्णन, अम्, n. rolling, tossing; fluctuating,
whirling round.

आ-घूर्णित, अस्, आ, अम्, rolled, rolling; whirled
round, fluctuating.
